attributes.name: walks_across_floor
attributes.text: The person walks so the body travels across the floor.
attributes.definition: The hips move a clear distance horizontally through a series of alternating steps.

attributes.name: steps_in_place
attributes.text: The feet keep lifting and landing without the body traveling.
attributes.definition: The feet leave and return to the floor repeatedly while the hips stay over the same spot.

attributes.name: both_feet_leave_ground
attributes.text: The whole body is in the air for a moment.
attributes.definition: Both feet are off the floor at the same time, so the hips rise above their standing height.

attributes.name: hips_lower
attributes.text: The hips move down toward the floor.
attributes.definition: The hip joints drop clearly from standing height during the action, by bending the knees.

attributes.name: hips_rise
attributes.text: The hips rise up from a low position.
attributes.definition: The hip joints move up from a low, bent-knee position toward standing height.

attributes.name: loses_balance
attributes.text: The body loses balance and sways or tips over.
attributes.definition: The torso moves outside the base of the feet in an uncontrolled way, with uneven steps, sway or a fall.

attributes.name: stands_on_one_leg
attributes.text: The body is balanced on one leg.
attributes.definition: For part of the action all body weight is on one foot while the other foot is off the floor.

attributes.name: weight_shifts_between_feet
attributes.text: Body weight shifts from the back foot to the front foot.
attributes.definition: The hips move from over one foot toward the other foot while both feet stay on the floor.

attributes.name: small_vertical_bounce
attributes.text: The whole body bobs up and down a little.
attributes.definition: The hips and head rise and fall slightly in repeated small bounces, with knees flexing.

attributes.name: body_turns_around
attributes.text: The body turns to face a new direction.
attributes.definition: The hips and shoulders rotate together about the vertical axis by a large amount, changing the facing direction.

attributes.name: body_stays_still
attributes.text: The legs and torso stay still while only arms or head move.
attributes.definition: The hips, knees and torso show almost no movement for the whole clip; only the arms, hands or head move.
